exposure_analysis.metric: ACLED conflict exposure (`population_best` in the source export): WorldPop-estimated residents within a type-dependent radius of each event (battles/explosions 5 km, riots 2 km, VAC 2 km / 5 km when fatal, protests 1 km, strategic developments none), Voronoi-deduped within location-period. Static 2020-22 WorldPop baseline — not displacement-adjusted.

strategic_developments.note: Strategic-development events are captured only on the event axis: ~no fatalities, and no exposure value by ACLED design (no radius assigned). Present in every event-based view; absent from every fatality- and exposure-based view.
